title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened duty bearers’ capacities by jointly modelling innovative and flexible learning opportunities that support skills development and productivity among underserved adolescents and young people. UNICEF is leveraging its convening power to bring together multi-sectoral stakeholders, both at the local and national levels, in establishing and investing in mutually beneficial alliances for youth development. In 2024, these interventions have benefitted 3,302 (1,678M/1,624F) adolescents and young people. In addition, UNICEF’s humanitarian response to support learning continuity benefitted a total of 14,595 learners (7,453M/7,142F) in the areas affected by a series of typhoons.;
